notes: The Council Chamber. Four chairs, a binding Accord primitive, three chat surfaces, faction treasuries, and an announce-then-execute window on irreversible commitments. VERSION NOTE: this work was drafted across 1.4.0.0 to 1.5.0.0 and is renumbered to 1.3.8.0, which is a straight patch increment on 1.3.7.6. The old numbering also COLLIDED with real history: v1.5.0.0 and v1.5.1.x already exist in the changelog from 2026-07-24. Nothing in the codebase compares version strings (apply.sh and ship.sh read it only as a commit message), so the renumber is safe. THE ACCORD: a pair of typed obligation lists the server escrows and executes atomically, plus a free text RIDER it stores and never acts on. Bonded and rider must never look alike; the day a player signs a rider believing the server held it, the guarantee dies permanently. Exactly one bonded clause kind, fund_colony, which BURNS into a war chest. A cash-transfer clause is deliberately absent: without the wire surcharge it is a better wire than the wire, and with it a 500,000,000 political payment costs 450,000,000 in tax. THE CHAIRS: Coalition is the existing Presidency (7 day term), Syndicate and Void are Legendary titles at 500,000,000 (72h terms), Guild is never for sale. TREASURIES: credits can become control or escrow and can NEVER become personal cash, by any path. Four refund routes go through ONE router reading payer_proposer/payer_counter. A bad leader can WASTE a treasury, never STEAL one. THE WINDOW: any commitment of TREASURY money to fund a RIVAL does not execute. It is held for 12 hours in which any seated leader of the ceding faction can pull it, including whoever takes the chair off the leader who committed it. This covers BOTH routes. The first cut gated the window on the ACCORD SHAPE rather than on the condition, which left the direct treasury spend uncovered: a leader could point /api/council/treasury/fund at a rival and it landed instantly, no counterparty, nobody able to pull it. Confirmed against a running server (lustandia void control 28% to 32% in one call) and closed by applying the same predicate at the source. 199 assertions across eleven suites. SERVER + CLIENT. Requires a restart. Hard refresh. CURRENCY GLYPH: 23 pre-existing instances of the wrong symbol, U+0192 (small f with hook) where U+0191 (capital F with hook) is the game's credit sign, corrected across server.js, galaxy.js and core.js. Warehouse rent and shortfall messages, faction bonus summaries, and notably the Chinese translations, where the English used U+0191 and the zh string directly beside it used U+0192. Ƒbay was already correct in all 17 of its uses. Historical CHANGELOG prose is left alone: it is a record of what was written at the time, not shipped copy.
